description:
You are a structural biologist. Go to the RCSB Protein Data Bank (rcsb.org) and research three specific protein structures: '4HHB' (Human Deoxyhemoglobin), '1MBN' (Sperm Whale Myoglobin), and '1FDH' (Human Fetal Deoxyhemoglobin). 

1. Create a JSON report at '~/Documents/protein_structures.json' containing the following metadata for each PDB ID: 'title', 'classification', 'method' (e.g. X-RAY DIFFRACTION), and 'resolution_angstroms' (as a number). Use the PDB IDs as keys (e.g., '4HHB').
2. Download the structure file for 4HHB in 'PDB Format' (often .pdb or .ent) to your Downloads folder.
3. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Protein Research' and bookmark the summary page for each of the three structures inside it.
